description: This PHP source file defines a class 'Smarty_Resource_Mysql' that implements a custom resource handler for Smarty templates using a MySQL database. It manages database connection setup, fetching template content and modification times, and encapsulates interactions with a 'templates' table in MySQL.

classes.name: Smarty_Resource_Mysql
classes.description: A resource handler class for Smarty templates stored in a MySQL database, providing methods to fetch template data and modification timestamps using PDO.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MySQL PDO connection and prepares SQL statements for fetching templates and timestamps.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Retrieves template source code and modification time from the database for a given template name.

methods.name: fetchTimestamp
methods.description: Retrieves the modification timestamp for a template from the database.
